description_id: Bundle skill + template Slide Master v2. Dua mode: narrative-arc (default — story arc 12 slide) dan template-picker (8 template student/worker). Tier change v2: Pro+ → All tiers (Starter+).

skills.description_id: Susun deck 12 slide pakai story arc problem→solution→market→traction→ask. Mode default — cocok buat pitch deck, customer pitch, internal review.
skills.description_en: Build a 12-slide deck using the problem→solution→market→traction→ask story arc. Default mode — good for pitch decks, customer pitches, internal reviews.

skills.description_id: Pilih dari template library (presentasi tugas, defense skripsi, weekly report, project update, training, kuliah). Mode opt-in saat customer minta 'deck dari template'.
skills.description_en: Pick from the template library (student assignment, thesis defense, weekly report, project update, training, lecture). Opt-in mode when customer asks 'deck dari template'.

skills.description_id: Generate template deck baru saat customer minta sesuatu yang belum ada di inventory. Pakai LLM customer (BYOK), simpan ke /var/lib/weuseai/customer-grown/.
skills.description_en: Generate a new deck template at runtime when the customer asks for something not in inventory.

templates.description_id: Presentasi tugas kuliah (8-10 slide) — judul, latar belakang, masalah, metode, hasil, kesimpulan, daftar pustaka. Format umum mata kuliah Indonesia.
templates.best_for: Mahasiswa S1 yang nyiapin presentasi tugas mata kuliah

templates.description_id: Defense / sidang skripsi (15-20 slide) — judul, BAB I summary, BAB II key references, BAB III metode, BAB IV findings, BAB V conclusion + recommendations, daftar pustaka, Q&A buffer.
templates.best_for: Mahasiswa S1/S2 yang sidang skripsi atau thesis

templates.description_id: Recap perkuliahan (8 slide) — minggu ke-N, learning outcomes, key concepts, contoh kasus, pertanyaan reflektif, action items.
templates.best_for: Mahasiswa atau pengajar yang ringkas materi kuliah

templates.description_id: Weekly report (6-8 slide) — highlights minggu ini, in-progress items, blockers, next week priorities, ask. Cocok buat 1-on-1 atau team standup mingguan.
templates.best_for: Karyawan yang report ke manager / tim

templates.description_id: Project update (10-12 slide) — project status (RAG), milestones achieved, current work, blockers, risks, next phase plan, decision-needed.
templates.best_for: PM atau project lead yang update stakeholder

templates.description_id: Training / onboarding deck (12-15 slide) — welcome, learning objectives, content sections, hands-on exercise, summary, resources, Q&A.
templates.best_for: Trainer atau team lead yang bikin onboarding deck
